hypothesis: Off-catalogue damage-zone ring emission: blind faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue express as a damage-zone halo off mapped traces, not on them.
mechanism: EDT distance from catalogue; keep ring; one dot per grid cell; binary dots on footprint; zero catalogue mass.
named_non_fault_process: Alluvial fans, Lahontan shoreline/beach ridges, and lithologic contacts can mimic edge/scarp signatures.

holdout_dti.note: training_features.tif / labels.tif require DrivenData login (not available in this sandbox); HOLDOUT-DTI (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular) cannot be computed without public truth.

leakage_canary.note: Method uses only the public catalogue + footprint (no training labels, no model fit, no feature-trained surface), so label leakage is structurally impossible; no feature-alone AUC to report.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.scope: Locally accessible research TIFFs (docs/downloads + data/scored_fleet), candidate self-excluded; not the organizer registry and not a complete accessible scan.
correlation_overlap_vs_registry.note: Overlap firings against continuous-surface rasters (support > 0.20) are geometric coverage, not methodological duplication; those rasters are evaluated by rank correlation (rho), which passes (max 0.109). Dot-field overlap is the method-unique comparison.
